title: Cherry-pick PR #799: Allow pasting engine paths and detect stockfish on PATH

source.notes: By ck-zhang. Translation conflicts resolved (UseStockfish key insertion + En Parlant~ branding).

description: Replace file-only engine picker with TextInput that accepts pasted paths. Adds ~ expansion, bare command name resolution via PATH lookup, and a Stockfish button when stockfish is detected on PATH. New Rust command find_executable_on_path with cross-platform support and tests.
done_criteria: Engine path TextInput accepts pasted paths
Stockfish detected on PATH shows quick-add button
